svg.title: Red Flags and Their Checks
svg.desc: Red flags matched to checks: an exact citation or section number is checked against the source, a precise statistic is traced to its origin, contradictory figures are reconciled, and one-sided or stereotyped wording is reviewed for bias.
svg.text: Specific-looking details are where hallucinations hide.
Check it in the official text
Trace it to the original source
Review for bias; describe equals equally
